name: The Reel Deal Deck
positioning: The first fly-fishing deck an angler would be proud to own. Original hand-drawn art, printed on genuine Bicycle stock, with a portion of every deck going to Trout Unlimited.

founders.name: Ken
founders.bio: Lifelong entrepreneur of more than thirty years, fifth-generation Idaho farmer, and the avid amateur angler who went looking for fly-fishing flashcards, came up empty-handed, and drew his own.

founders.name: Audrey
founders.bio: Entrepreneurship graduate of Loyola Marymount University's College of Business Administration, December 2025. Handles design direction, brand and community — and is the reason the drawings became a deck instead of a folder on a laptop.

voice.source: Transcribed verbatim from the info card printed in the deck (Fly_deck_faces_v8 #56). Use these words; do not paraphrase them into marketing-speak.
voice.intro: We're Ken and Audrey, a father-daughter team of multigenerational Idaho farmers and entrepreneurs.
voice.why: And as passionate fly anglers, we are dedicated to catch-and-release fishing and protecting our headwaters and trout habitats. That's why we created The Reel Deal Deck — exquisite hand-drawn playing cards that teach while you play.
voice.hope: We hope this deck sparks joy, conversation, and a deeper love for the sport.
voice.signoff: Thank you for your support. Tight lines!
voice.shortLine: Hand-drawn playing cards that teach while you play.
voice.note: The printed card says 'multigenerational Idaho farmers' of the pair. The Kickstarter, written by Ken and Audrey themselves, calls Ken a '5th generation Idaho farmer' — so the number is now on the public record for him and founders[0].bio uses it. Still TODO-CONFIRM: surnames, and whether Audrey counts as fifth or sixth generation.
voice.register: How the site itself should sound, as distinct from voice.intro/why/hope/signoff, which are printed-card text and must be quoted verbatim. Write as Ken and Audrey, not about them: 'we made', 'we would rather', never 'Ken and Audrey decided' on a page they are speaking on. Warm, plain and a little wry — a father and daughter showing you a thing they made, not a brand announcing a product. Specific over grand, and never a claim we cannot back. No exclamation marks and no emoji: that is their Instagram voice, and it does not survive the move to a page someone is reading to decide whether to spend $19.95. Third person is still right in schema, alt text, press boilerplate and product facts ('signed by Ken and Audrey').

cardCraft.suits: A two-colour deck: green replaces red on hearts and diamonds, bark brown replaces black on spades and clubs — drawn from the tuck box and card back.
cardCraft.backDesign: An engraved green border framing two rising trout and an angler on the river.
cardCraft.jokers: Two jokers carry a trout-in-a-jester's-cap mark instead of a rank: the Egg and the San Juan Worm.
cardCraft.infoCard: A 56th card carries Ken and Audrey's note, the site address and the Trout Unlimited Business mark.
cardCraft.eachCard: Every card shows the rank and suit, the fly's name, its category, the hand-drawn fly itself, a plain-English note on what it imitates, and the hook sizes it is usually tied in.
cardCraft.printer: The United States Playing Card Company

brand.note: The canonical entity. Every Organization node on the site is emitted from this via organizationSchema() in src/templates/_blocks.mjs. Do not describe the brand differently anywhere else — a single, repeated description is what lets search engines and language models resolve this into one confident entity instead of a fuzzy one.
brand.name: The Reel Deal Deck
brand.slogan: Hand-drawn playing cards that teach while you play.
brand.description: The Reel Deal Deck is a 54-card fly-fishing playing card deck made by Ken and Audrey, a father-and-daughter team in Eagle, Idaho. Every card carries an original hand-drawn fly, a plain-English note on what it imitates, and the hook sizes it is usually tied in. story.note: Ken and Audrey's own account, condensed from the Kickstarter campaign. Full transcript and the rules for writing in this voice: docs/VOICE-SOURCE.md. Do not add a beat that is not sourced there.
story.hook: Fly fishing is full of beauty, tradition and endless learning. It is also full of hundreds of flies, each with its own name, purpose and history — which is exciting, and a little overwhelming.
story.looking: Ken fishes with friends who can talk patterns all afternoon, and some of the finer details went over his head. He went looking for a set of fly-fishing flashcards he would actually want to own, and came up empty-handed.
story.twist: So he drew his own, one fly at a time. Then came the twist that turned a study aid into something people would keep: why not make them playing cards too?
story.belief: We think a product can do more than sell. It can teach, start a conversation, bring people together, and talk somebody into an afternoon outside.
story.spirit: It is a small product with a big spirit behind it.
goal: special enough to leave on a coffee table, in a cabin or in a gear bag
story.forWhom: For anglers of every level, for the friend hunting a gift that feels personal, and for anyone who likes the art and the culture as much as the fishing.
story.thanks: We are so glad you are here.

shop.note: Where every "buy" link on the site points, resolved once by orderState() in src/templates/_blocks.mjs. Checkout is hosted on Shopify, so `url` is the only place the storefront is named. Leave it empty and every CTA falls back to `fallback` — the on-site pricing panel — so the site is never broken while the store is being set up. Never paste a store URL into a page.

pricing.note: The one source of pricing truth. src/pages/deck.mjs and src/pages/wholesale.html both read it; the Product JSON-LD offer is built from it. Three units, and they nest: a brick is twelve decks, a master case is twelve bricks.

retail.note: One deck is $19.95 plus $6.95 shipping. Two or more decks are $19.95 each and shipping is free. There is no quantity discount at retail — the saving is the shipping.

wholesale.note: Wholesale is per-deck pricing, and it is sold in whole units only: a brick or a master case, never a loose deck.

account.note: The wholesale account flow. /wholesale/apply/ posts to the Netlify function in netlify/functions/, which creates the Shopify customer tagged `wholesale`, stores the resale permit on the customer record, and returns a pre-filled cart. Wholesale PRICES are not gated by this site — they come from a Shopify automatic discount targeted at the `wholesale` customer segment, which is what makes the order link safe to share. Setup runbook: docs/WHOLESALE-ACCOUNTS.md.
account.liveNote: The master switch for the application form. FALSE while the site is on GitHub Pages, where /api/wholesale-apply is a 404 and the form has nowhere to post: the page then shows the email route instead of a form that would fail and blame the applicant's connection. Set true the day the site moves to Netlify AND the Shopify environment variables are set — not before, and not one without the other. Nothing else needs changing.
account.autoApproveNote: Approved on signup, as asked. The resale permit is collected and stored but not checked by anyone before pricing is granted. Set REVIEW_ONLY=1 in the Netlify environment to queue applications as `wholesale-pending` instead — the discount does not match that tag, so nothing else needs changing.
